consent.text: We use cookies to measure the site and our campaigns. They only turn on if you accept.
consent.label: Cookie preferences

sections.p: Sebastián Darío Goiburo (tax ID CUIT 20-34889769-2), based in Mendoza, Argentina, trading as Exacta Transformación Digital, is responsible for the personal data you leave on this site and over WhatsApp. You can write to us at {email}.

What you enter in our forms (name, email, phone, company and website), your assessment answers and whatever you tell us in your messages, including WhatsApp conversations, which a virtual assistant powered by artificial intelligence answers first and a person afterwards. We also record which campaign or page brought you here. If you subscribe to the blog, we keep your email and the date you confirmed.

To send you your reading, answer your inquiry, contact you about our services and assess whether we can help. From your answers we internally estimate how close your company is to the projects we work on. If you subscribed, also to send you the blog articles until you unsubscribe, using the link in each email.

We don’t sell your data. It’s processed by the providers we use to operate: site hosting, email, automation and messaging tools, Meta (WhatsApp) and Anthropic, which provides the assistant’s artificial intelligence model. If you accept cookies, Meta and Google receive browsing data to measure our campaigns.

Measurement and advertising cookies only turn on if you accept them, and you can change your choice from the link in the footer. Those the site needs to work, such as your preferred theme or language, don’t require acceptance.

You can access your data, correct it or ask us to delete it by writing to {email}. Under Argentine Law 25,326, you may exercise the right of access free of charge at intervals of no less than six months, unless you prove a legitimate interest. The Agency for Access to Public Information, which oversees that law, handles complaints.
